sloka: ततः सर्वा दिशो दृष्ट्वा प्रदिशाः च समावृताः ।राक्षसैः सर्वतः प्राप्तैः शर वर्षाभिः आवृतः ॥३-२५-३६॥
transliteration: tataḥ sarvā diśo dṛṣṭvā pradiśāḥ ca samāvṛtāḥ ।rākṣasaiḥ sarvataḥ prāptaiḥ śara varṣābhiḥ āvṛtaḥ ॥3-25-36॥

translations.english: As the infuriated demons again hurtled towards Rama, filling the quarters and the intermediate directions and raining missiles, Rama aimed at them dazzling gandharvastras, producing a frightening warcry.
